title: Zelensky to Visit U.K. as Ukraine Presses Allies on Intelligence Sharing
summary_full: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine received “no early warning from our partners” about a Russian attack. President Trump has said Washington is still “sharing intel.”
